digest.component_or_area: Jira outbound comment differ and parent breadcrumb generation
propositions: When a child ticket's parent cannot be represented in Jira because the parent is non-epic and the project permits only Epic parents, the parent field is suppressed in the outbound differ but the child lands without context.

An echo-safe breadcrumb comment must be emitted from the outbound comment differ that points to the nearest ancestor with a bound Jira key, marked with a stable identity tag to prevent duplicate additions across passes.
The breadcrumb body is suppressed inbound by the RECONCILER_MARKER substring check in inbound collection diffs to prevent re-ingestion loops.
If intervening ancestors lack bound Jira keys, the breadcrumb skips them and names the nearest bound ancestor while noting the missing intermediate levels.
The breadcrumb append is idempotent via dedup on the stable tag, so changing nearest represented ancestors across passes does not create conflicting comments.
No breadcrumb is emitted when no ancestor in the hierarchy has a bound Jira key.
